evals.name: register-dialogs
evals.prompt: Register the confirmation and busy dialogs for all author screens.
evals.expected_output: A single App.tsx registration inside Arc.
assertions: Imports the listing slice's Authors and supplies its required onOpen(author) callback.

evals.name: remove-author
evals.prompt: Confirm before removing an author. Dismissing or choosing No must do nothing.
evals.expected_output: Await a yes/no confirmation before calling remove.
assertions: Calls useConfirmationDialog in the descendant component.
Invokes the supplied removal operation only for Yes.

evals.name: recover-failure
evals.prompt: Prevent a repeated removal request and let readers retry after the server rejects it.
evals.expected_output: Disable the button across confirmation and removal; show failure and release pending state.
assertions: Disables the action before opening the dialog.
Awaits the removal and reports rejection as failure.
Releases pending state in all paths including No and rejection.
